title: About Glazed Prize Habitat Wall
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1210 recent saved-signal files and 314 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around @simulat_: Royal Mowch and Detroit Is Changing Fast. Here’s What Locals Think Its Future Should Look Like, plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Glazed Prize Habitat Wall: Bright glazed poster habitat wall, torn poster wall composition archetype with side-lit object slab grammar: a near-white central calm field holds a small low-center crowned abstract mass, rounded side lobes and faint shadow only. Dense pasted strata crowd the edges and lower band, torn strips exposing nine physical... After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against central white plaster-paper calm field, lower crowned glazed figure and crown chip, and left flower aperture with torn white rim.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
